features: 30W Powerful Stereo Sound: Experience rich, punchy bass and immersive audio for Bollywood beats, movies, gaming, and party sessions.
Dynamic LED Party Lights: Vibrant RGB lights sync with your music to create an exciting club-like atmosphere for every celebration.

Multiple Playback Options: Play music your way with Bluetooth, USB, AUX, TF Card, FM Radio, and TWS pairing to connect two speakers for bigger sound.
Portable & Party-Ready Design: Lightweight yet powerful speaker, perfect for home parties, birthdays, picnics, outdoor gatherings, and karaoke sessions.
